meta_description: Open-source software for monitoring the KPIs of research infrastructure services: service registry, monthly submission, dashboards and a public catalogue.
og_title: Scorpion: KPI monitoring for research infrastructure services
og_description: Providers submit their figures month by month, consortia follow them in dashboards and reports. Open source under the ISC licence.
og_image_alt: Scorpion logo with the words “Scorpion: Streamlining Federated KPI Monitoring”
hero_text: Scorpion is open-source software for monitoring the key performance indicators (KPIs) of research infrastructure services. Service providers register their services and submit their figures month by month, and consortia follow them in dashboards and reports.
get_started_docs_text: User, administrator and developer guides, and the terms Scorpion uses.
get_started_api_text: The OpenAPI reference of the public REST API, version 1.
get_started_demo_text: Try Scorpion on a test instance with sample data.
instance_denbi_description: For the services of de.NBI, the German Network for Bioinformatics Infrastructure, and ELIXIR Germany.
instance_nfdi_description: For the services of the NFDI consortia.
feature_registry_text: Register services with licence, stage, description, links to the same service elsewhere and contacts, together with the organisations that run them, identified by their ROR ids. Each instance has its own name, logos, theme colours and legal texts.
feature_kpis_text: Define indicators with value types and units, and choose a set of KPIs for each service.
feature_submission_text: Submit figures in the web UI, as a CSV or XLSX file, or through the API. Every value is validated, and a service has one value per indicator and month.
feature_analytics_text: Follow each indicator month by month, with change, average and volatility, and export the numbers.
feature_impact_text: Figures at consortium level: services per stage, the share of open-source services, and headline KPIs for each year.
feature_catalogue_text: A searchable catalogue of the published services, with exports as schema.org and RIMO data in Turtle and JSON-LD.
feature_api_text: Version 1 of the REST API, with an OpenAPI reference on each instance and personal access tokens.
feature_access_text: Sign in with your institution through OpenID Connect, or with a local account. Roles and provider membership decide who may do what. Notifications and an inbox keep people informed, and an audit trail records changes.
feature_security_text: A self-assessment against OWASP ASVS 5.0 Level 2 for authentication, sessions, authorisation and OpenID Connect is in progress.
feature_security_badges: OpenSSF badges of the application repository, as of {date}:

privacy_meta_description: How the Scorpion landing page at scorpion.bi.denbi.de handles personal data: a server access log kept for 7 days, no cookies, no tracking.
privacy_scope: This privacy policy covers the Scorpion landing page at scorpion.bi.denbi.de, in English and German. The Scorpion instances at /denbi/ and /nfdi/ and the demo instance are separate services with their own privacy policies.
privacy_controller_text: The controller under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:
privacy_controller_name: Leibniz Institute of Plant Genetics and Crop Plant Research (IPK)
privacy_contact_text: For questions about data protection and to exercise your rights, contact IPK’s data protection officer:
privacy_logs_text: When you open a page, your browser sends a request to our web server. The server records each request in an access log: your IP address, the date and time, the requested address, the status and size of the response, the page you came from if your browser sends it, and your browser’s identification (user agent).
privacy_logs_purpose: We use the log only to run the site securely and to find and fix errors. It is not combined with other data, and it is not used to identify or profile visitors. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(e) GDPR.
privacy_logs_retention: The log entries are deleted automatically after 7 days.
privacy_nothing_text: The site sets no cookies and stores nothing in your browser. It uses no analytics, no tracking and no social media plugins. Fonts, images and scripts all come from our own server, so opening the site sends no request to anyone else.
privacy_events_text: The list of upcoming events is loaded from our own server as well. The server fetches the list from GitHub at regular intervals by itself. Your visit causes no request to GitHub, and no data about you is passed to GitHub.
privacy_links_text: The site links to other sites, for example GitHub, the Scorpion instances, the documentation and the IPK website. When you follow such a link, the privacy policy of that site applies.
privacy_rights_text: You have the right of access to your personal data (Art. 15 GDPR), to rectification (Art. 16), to erasure (Art. 17), to restriction of processing (Art. 18) and to object to processing (Art. 21). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR).
